set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'INVENTORY_PY'
import os,json,subprocess,datetime
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path.home()/'repos/touristic-digital-platform.git'
target_branch='refs/heads/chore/journey-audit-coverage-admission-20261031'
text=subprocess.check_output(['git','--git-dir='+str(repo),'worktree','list','--porcelain'],text=True)
matched=[]
for block in text.strip().split('\n\n'):
 lines=block.splitlines()
 if 'branch '+target_branch in lines: matched.append(dict(line.split(' ',1) for line in lines if ' ' in line))
processes=[]
for proc in Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not proc.name.isdigit(): continue
 try:
  cwd=os.readlink(proc/'cwd')
  if any(cwd==item.get('worktree') or cwd.startswith(item.get('worktree','!')+'/') for item in matched):
   processes.append({'pid':int(proc.name),'name':(proc/'comm').read_text().strip(),'cwd':cwd})
 except (OSError,PermissionError): pass
head=subprocess.check_output(['gh','api','repos/luizanunciostoca/touristic-digital-platform/pulls/1337','--jq','.head.sha'],text=True).strip()
tree=subprocess.check_output(['git','--git-dir='+str(repo),'rev-parse',head+'^{tree}'],text=True).strip()
print(json.dumps({'kind':'NATIVE_BARE_PUBLICATION_CHANNEL_INVENTORY','observedAt':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'branch':target_branch,'headSha':head,'treeSha':tree,'matchingMaterialWorktrees':matched,'processesInMatchingMaterialWorktrees':processes,'processInventoryLimit':'Read-only PID/comm/cwd of worktrees for this exact branch; does not attest global absence of all possible external writers.','bareStorePresent':repo.is_dir()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
